ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (214) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

Names keep Tolstoy's forms and diminutives as each speaker uses them: Korney Vasiliev (Korney Vasilich in address, Kornyushka from Kuzma), Agafya / Agashka / Agasha / Gasha, Fyodor / Fedka. The peasant form «Петра» (Petra, for Pyotr) is rendered Pyotr so the workman is not misread as a woman, «без вина» (bez vina, 'without wine') is 'without liquor', since the word means spirits here, and «грех развяжем» (grekh razvyazhem, 'we'll untie the sin') is kept literal.
